card_says: The company name on the card gives the shareholdings as Eskom 44% and Globeleq 56% at the start, with a 20-year distribution concession from 2005.
source_says: Those shares are described as the holding at the start. By the end of its concession Umeme was listed on the Uganda Securities Exchange and cross-listed on the Nairobi Securities Exchange, and the 2025 report does not mention Eskom or Globeleq. The government told Umeme in November 2022 that the concession would not be renewed; it ended and the network was handed to the state company UEDCL on 31 March 2025, after which Umeme's staff fell from 2,409 to 18.

source.title: After 20 years in Uganda, Umeme is now eyeing Sierra Leone

card_says: Coal miner obliged to resettle, headquarters Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
source_says: Vale bought the Colombian coal assets in 2008 for US$308m and agreed in 2012 to sell the El Hatillo mine, the Cerro Largo deposit, Sociedad Portuaria Rio Cordoba and 8.43% of the FENOCO railway to Colombian Natural Resources, then controlled by Goldman Sachs; Murray Energy in turn bought Colombian Natural Resources and its Colombian assets, including the La Francia and El Hatillo mines, in August 2015. A Brazilian head office fits the Vale period rather than the owners that followed.

source.title: Goldman-controlled Colombian Natural Resources to buy Vale's mines

source_says: Sempra's own about-us page does not mention IEnova (Infraestructura Energetica Nova). It lists Sempra's Mexican assets, including the Energia Costa Azul LNG terminal in Baja California, under Sempra Infrastructure Partners, in which Sempra holds a part interest. The card's wording may describe the position at the time of the case rather than now.

card_says: Bought RCA's consumer electronics arm (1988 per the Taipei Times).
source_says: Britannica dates the purchase of General Electric's consumer electronics division, which included RCA, to 1987, and says the arm was renamed Thomson Consumer Electronics in 1988. The 1988 date on the card matches the renaming rather than the purchase.
Shareholders approved the change of the company's name to Webuild on 4 May 2020, after the merger with Astaldi; the name Salini Impregilo belongs to the period before that date.

source.title: Salini Impregilo becomes Webuild: bigger, stronger and ready to serve the nation
